answer: Attendance across several sessions is linked into one chain where each session token references the previous one, and the horizon of the design is that the chain is verified end to end before any reward is paid. The bridge of the scheme is that skipping a middle session breaks the chain, so partial attendance cannot be presented as complete. A Sybil would need to be present at every session to forge a full chain, and the quartz of the linkage makes a gap visible to any verifier.
